grain.olist_order_items: one row per order_id and order_item_id
grain.olist_order_payments: one row per order_id and payment_sequential
grain.olist_order_reviews: one row per review_id and order_id
grain.olist_geolocation: multiple coordinates per zip code prefix
grain.olist_product_category_translation: one row per Portuguese category name

safety_notes: Payments and reviews may contain multiple rows per order; aggregate them before joining to order items.
Geolocation contains multiple rows per zip code prefix; create a canonical zip-level view before joining.
Order item price excludes freight_value; metrics must state whether freight is included.
customer_id identifies an order-level customer record; customer_unique_id represents the cross-order person.
